response.sql: WITH circuit_avgs AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) as circuit_avg_round FROM races r INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), country_baselines AS (SELECT country, AVG(circuit_avg_round) as country_baseline FROM circuit_avgs GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_avg_round, ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.country_baseline as difference FROM circuit_avgs ca INNER JOIN country_baselines cb ON ca.country = cb.country ORDER BY CASE WHEN ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.country_baseline IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ca.circuit_avg_round - cb.country_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
